exposure: landmark_exposure equals 1 for a recorded scheduled follow-up encounter within 30 days
event: first emergency or inpatient return after landmark through day 365 after index discharge
observed_time: days from landmark to first later acute return, pre-event death, or administrative end
administrative_censor: day 365 after index discharge, which is day 335 after landmark
competing_event: recorded death after landmark and before first later acute return

ph_screen.method: Spearman association between event-level Schoenfeld residual and log event time
ph_screen.failed_action: foreground fixed-time Kaplan-Meier evidence and refer time-varying modeling to Module 04

claim_boundary: synthetic observational association; not a probability from the Cox model, risk ratio, causal effect, or real clinical result
